says: In our tooling, the pr-check-file-laws plan's Files table git-mvs oxlint-plugins/no-node-filesystem.test.ts (line 486) and oxlint-plugins/one-id-module.test.ts (line 492) to .integration.test.ts names, but the trusted-rules pull request (0573) deletes both files and moves their laws into no-node-imports.test.ts and modules.test.ts. The same table does not list the new oxlint-plugins/effect-checks-held.test.ts, which starts a child process (git ls-files), so by 0584 it is a test that table should rename too.
proof: git show origin/main:docs/plan/quests/pr-check-file-laws-PLAN.md lines 486 and 492 name the two files; pull request kamp-us/tea-fabrika#1498 deletes them; oxlint-plugins/effect-checks-held.test.ts on that branch calls execFileSync("git", ["ls-files", ...]) and is not named in the plan.
cost: Whichever pull request lands second meets a git mv of a missing file, and one process-starting test stays a plain test.
